label: finboost-p45-force-ab
_why: PROBES 4 AND 5 OF AT MOST FIVE for the finish boost. The user, 2026-09-23: "Firing or not firing, have you observed different AI propensity for choosing certain techs? Make something fire to check." Nothing had: three probes showed the trigger evaluates (219/219) and the patched files load, but no boosted technology ever met the condition, so the AI's response was never observed. This FORCES it. Two arms, identical except the boost: config/mod_config.probe-fin-force-on.json and probe-fin-force-off.json = the canon with research_events.finish_boost.force_test — once in February 1836 every country gets ONE technology pushed into [0.99, 1) of its cost (the first researchable of sixteen low-weight era-1/2 technologies the AI chose 0 times in probe 1's 718 choices, none of them JE-covered), stepped until has_technology_progress itself says >= 0.99, and every research choice afterwards is logged. ON: enabled true (+10000 at >= 0.99 on all 181 researchable technologies). OFF: enabled false (no boost).

_questions.Q1: Does the forcing land every forced technology in [0.99, 1) of its cost (PMR_FORCE prog/cost), and never complete one?
_questions.Q2_the_point: Of the countries forced, what share make the forced technology their NEXT research choice — ON against OFF?
_questions.Q3: How long from forcing to acquisition, ON against OFF (the V3TB TECH lines)?

_predictions.Q1: Every forced line reads prog/cost in [0.99, 1.00); no PMR_FORCE line followed by an immediate acquisition.
_predictions.Q2: ON: at least 90% of forced countries pick the forced technology as their next choice (+10000 against vanilla weights of 1–3, a randomisation of 0.5–2x, and an ahead-of-time divisor of at most ~1 + 1.25 x Σ). OFF: under 10% (these technologies drew 0 of 718 choices in probe 1).
_predictions.Q3: ON: acquisition within about a week of the country's next choice. OFF: most forced technologies still unacquired at 1838.1.1.

_cost: 2 runs x 1836.1.1 -> 1838.1.1, about 3-4 minutes each plus builds.
_caveats: One seed per arm. Q2 is a share over ~250-300 countries INSIDE each run, so it resolves at n=1; the two arms' worlds diverge after February 1836 only through research choices.
A country whose next choice was made BEFORE its pulse forced it (its research finished between the window's start and its pulse) is still counted by the choice AFTER the force line.
Tech spread can complete a forced technology in either arm if it happens to be that country's spreading technology; both arms share that.
Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
_run_order: ON then OFF, back to back (two configs, one decision; not an alternation).
